name: client-resource-access-action-negative-test-1519220005/client-resource-path-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed; object-constructor-expr is not listed.
### Other invocation restrictions: "Client resource access actions require an atomic client receiver. Dispatch is not supported when more than one resource method matches the access path."
reason: The negative cases depend on an anonymous client object constructor (`var successClient = client object { ... };`). Object constructor expressions are not covered by the Expressions positive list; support for object/class members and new expressions does not establish this expression form. This essential uncovered construct suffices for whole-case feature classification.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous client object constructor expression: `client object { resource function ... }`.
test_design_notes: The file asserts compile-time rejection via @error comments for invalid resource paths and path argument types; there are no @args, @panic, or @output directives. Negative rejection alone would remain in scope if all prerequisite constructs were supported.
